messages:
alex: kicking off a microshift from router pool v2.7.1 -> v2.8.0 in eu-west1. plan: drip 1% every 2m for 20m, safety net checks, auto-roll to v2.7.1 on errors. @maria you good with the healthcheck config?

maria: yup, healthcheck 200 only, 95% successful reqs threshold. I'll watch metrics. :eyes:

ryan: add CPU and p95 latency alert at +30% over baseline. If either fires -> pause and rollback. Also ensure trace sampling on.

jamie: updated router policy. snippet:
```
route: /api/generate
traffic_split:
  - version: v2.8.0
    weight: 1
  - version: v2.7.1
    weight: 99
window: 2m
step: 1%
rollback_triggers:
  latency: p95 > baseline * 1.3
  errors: 5%+ 5m
```

deploy-bot: scheduled microshift job 1893456795 by alex
deploy-bot: starting step 1 -> 1% to v2.8.0 (timestamp: 1893456800)

maria: seeing new instances warming, no 5xx so far. CPU slightly up on v2.8.0 nodes.

ops-bot: perf-check: p50=12ms p95=82ms baseline p95=70ms (delta +17%). Not over threshold yet.

ryan: ok hold for next 2m and re-evaluate. if p95 > 91ms then rollback.

deploy-bot: step 5 -> 5% to v2.8.0 completed (timestamp: 1893456920)

maria: noticed a small spike in auth latency on v2.8.0 traces, investigating.

alex: if root cause is auth timeout, revert auth change only? prefer full rollback unless narrowing fix within 10m.

jamie: pinned v2.8.0 to router tag 'microshift-1893456789' for trace correlation.

deploy-bot: step 10 -> 10% (timestamp: 1893457040)

ops-bot: error-rate increased to 3.7% on v2.8.0 over last 2m (baseline 0.6%). Below rollback 5% but trending up.

maria: can we enable header-based routing for affected customers as mitigation? might reduce blast radius.

alex: good idea. implement header filter for 10% traffic subset and route back to v2.7.1. Keep overall drip running.

jamie: applied header-rule 'x-customer-group=A' -> route to v2.7.1 for that subset.

ryan: monitoring. if error-rate crosses 5% or p95 > 91ms we abort and full rollback.

maria: continuing triage, will post findings in 10m.

alex: thanks team. will document postmortem if we rollback. :thumbsup:
